findings: Paired aligned rings and wheel internals enclose the new stepped shaft and bushes. The outer nut, locking plate, backing flange and six cap screws are visible in the assembled view.

The mounting-only view exposes inner riveted and outer screwed bearing flanges and two receiver coupons. Scallops clear nearby heads after the initial locking plate collided with one head at each end.

The proxy receiver coupons are study geometry, not historical tank parts. Actual M1977/M1978 hull identity and installation fit remain unresolved. Exact casting outlines, thread forms, lubrication passages and retention strength are inferred or unqualified.
